record.paper_title: Bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces: new results and open problems
record.original_question: Determine the exact value of M*(H^p), the dual compact approximation constant of the Hardy space H^p, for every 1 < p < ∞.

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.5. (b) Find the exact value of M∗(Hp), 1 < p < ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $1 < p < \infty$ and let $H^p$ denote the classical Hardy space on the unit disk, i.e. the Banach space of holomorphic functions $f$ on $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ such that
$$\|f\|_{H^p} := \sup_{0 \le r < 1} \left(\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi} |f(re^{i\theta})|^p\,d\theta\right)^{1/p} < \infty.$$

For a Banach space $X$, denote by $B(X)$ the algebra of bounded linear operators on $X$ and by $K(X)$ the ideal of compact operators. The space $X$ is said to have the dual compact approximation property (DCAP) with constant $C$ if there exists a net $(T_\alpha) \subset K(X)$ such that the adjoints $T_\alpha^*$ converge to the identity on $X^*$ in the strong operator topology and $\sup_\alpha \|T_\alpha\| \le C$. The dual compact approximation constant $M^*(X)$ is defined as
$$M^*(X) := \inf\{C \ge 1 : X \text{ has DCAP with constant } C\},$$
with $M^*(X) = \infty$ if $X$ does not have DCAP.

Determine the exact value of $M^*(H^p)$ for every $1 < p < \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in the literature on bounded/dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces. Known results give the upper bound $M^*(H^p) \le 2^{|1-2/p|}$, with the trivial value $M^*(H^2)=1$, but the exact value for $p \ne 2$ does not appear to have been determined; no later work establishing the exact value was found.
